stories.title: Structured Error Handling for Tool Routing
stories.description: Implement standardized error handling for disallowed tools and Pydantic validation failures, including safe user-facing messages and internal error classification without leaking sensitive details.

stories.title: Tool Routing Observability and Debug Logging
stories.description: Integrate tool routing events with debug_logger to capture tool selection, allowlist decisions, validation outcomes, and execution timing for audit and troubleshooting.

stories.title: Extensible Tool Registration Mechanism
stories.description: Refactor allowlist definition into a centralized, easily extendable registry pattern that maps tool names to handlers and Pydantic models, enabling safe addition of new tools without modifying core routing logic.
